text:
Lina (Marketing): Quick pulse from today's launch play test — small cohort only, but good signal on templates + credits combo.
Omar (Growth): Signup lift +3.4% vs baseline on the seeded post. Engagement looks concentrated in the first 48h.
Tess (Product): Which funnel are we routing webinar signups into? Want to ensure fair distribution across credit tiers.
Ravi (Eng): We can gate arms behind a rollout flag. Recommend 25% high-credit, 75% baseline. Router needs cohort tag: launchpulse_v1.
Lina (Marketing): Use tag=launchpulse_v1 and creative=template_pack. For copy, I'm drafting two posts: 1) benchmark narrative (internal ranges), 2) quickstart templates + CTA. Will share drafts.
June (Ops): I'll encode routing rule and set spend alert at $250/day for the cohort. If exceeded, auto-scale down high-credit to 10%.
Omar (Growth): Targets: 7-day activation +5pp relative, 14-day retention lift. Also track "template adoption" metric: % users executing a shipped template within 24h.
Tess (Product): For webinar planning: Thurs 10am PT. Speakers: Tess, Ravi, and customer Alex. Need dedicated infra and a short demo flow that finishes in <6m.
Ravi (Eng): I'll reserve demo capacity and add lightweight instrumentation for avg tokens/use and completion success flag.
Lina (Marketing): For public messaging avoid exact latency/cost numbers. Use phrasing like "fast responses for common prompts" and call out internal benchmarks in the landing copy.
Omar (Growth): Email variants: Subject A = "75 credits + templates to get you started" vs Subject B = "Start building with our template pack". Track open->signup conversion and downstream activation.
June (Ops): Action list: deploy router JSON with tag, set rollout flag 25% (today), configure spend alert (today).
Lina (Marketing): I'll post drafts and landing copy by EOD; Omar will wire email variants tomorrow; Tess/Ravi to confirm demo and instrumentation tomorrow morning. Reconvene Wed 9am PT. :sparkles:
